free_tier.stated: $400 in free credits on a 30-day trial ('Start your 30-day Snowflake trial today. Get $400 in credits'). No byte quota — storage is billed from the credit balance.

retention.stated: retention: 'Snowflake trial account credits may be used within 30 days'; 'If you don't upgrade before the trial period ends, the account is suspended and any unused free usage balance expires' and 'you may lose access to your data'.

egress.terms: Data leaves via query results, not object GETs; no egress-free download path.

tooling: Snowflake SQL API / Snowpark; internal stages + `GET`/`PUT` for file transfer. No rclone backend; files sit inside stages or named internal stages, not a general object store.
chaining: New email = new trial, explicitly ('you can sign up ... all you need is a valid email address; no payment information'). So $400 x N throwaway trials — but each dies at 30 days.
